name: instrumental
description: Music with no singing or spoken words, only instruments.

name: acoustic
description: Natural, unamplified instruments such as acoustic guitar and piano instead of electronic production.

name: high energy
description: Loud, lively, powerful tracks with a lot of drive.

name: low energy
description: Soft, quiet, understated tracks that stay in the background.

name: fast tempo
description: Quick beats per minute that keep things moving.

name: slow tempo
description: Unhurried beats per minute with plenty of space.

name: danceable
description: A strong, steady groove that is easy to move to.

name: popular
description: Widely played songs that most listeners already know.

name: underground
description: Less-played songs that few listeners have discovered.

name: lyrical
description: Songs where spoken or rapped words carry the track.
